{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Read the data dictionary
dict_df = pd.read_csv('data/data_dictionary.md', sep='|', skiprows=1, engine='python')
dict_df.columns = dict_df.columns.str.strip()

dict_df = dict_df[dict_df['Variable Name'].str.strip().str.startswith('baseline_biomarker')]

# Display the first few rows of the trial data and the data dictionary
trial_df.head(), dict_df"}
